items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: He was a very nice player.

ctx.x: And what about, uh, was Tony Newstead going at that time?

Tony Newstead was playing about, he never seemed to, sort of, uh, get a band and keep it for any length of time. He was, uh, uh, you'd call on a Chicago kick. Um. Mm-hmm. Like, to play, uh, a bit like Bix. Um. It was looser stuff, in many ways, um, happier, sort of easygoing stuff. He was a very nice player. Mm-hmm. Uh, but he was never a, sort of a, a force as a band leader. The bands were Graham Bell and the Southern Jazz Group, followed by Frank Johnson and Lynn Bernard. They're about the four bands as such.…
Well, what did Frank Johnson and Lynn Bernard play?
